text_markup: Unless an instruction explicitly specifies the zone from which an object must be selected as a target, only counters in the play area and installed cards are valid targets for that instruction.
text_plain: Unless an instruction explicitly specifies the zone from which an object must be selected as a target, only counters in the play area and installed cards are valid targets for that instruction.

examples.text_markup: The Corp resolves a subroutine that says "[sub] The Runner trashes 1 program." The Runner must trash 1 of their installed programs and may not trash a program from their grip or stack.
examples.text_plain: The Corp resolves a subroutine that says "{sub} The Runner trashes 1 program." The Runner must trash 1 of their installed programs and may not trash a program from their grip or stack.
